about: Every asset that can reach air or a published file, with its rights. server/compliance/credits.js reads it; test/compliance-credits.test.js fails when a file in the repository or an asset in an episode has no record here. Checked 17 Oct 2026.

channel-original.what: Presenters, sets, studios, press room, graphics, logo, bitmap fonts, icons, maps' styling, the ident and the opens: drawn in code by GLOBIT 24

channel-music.what: Themes, signatures, stingers, music beds and sound effects: composed and synthesised in code (WebAudio)

channel-data.what: The channel's own data: gazetteer, weather grid, casting, rates, look tables, the election calendar's rule

fixture-art.what: The offline demo's pictures and pages (config/fixtures, drawn by config/fixtures/make-images.mjs) for fictional outlets; never published

lab-samples.what: Voice and music samples rendered for the lab pages and the owner's listening (public/lab, music proposals); never on air
lab-samples.licence: original output of the channel's own voice engine

synthetic-voices.what: Every voice on air: the channel's open-source text-to-speech engine and its voice files (tools/voice, data/models), run on our own machine
synthetic-voices.credit: Voices: synthetic, made with an open-source text-to-speech engine (Apache 2.0)

natural-earth.what: The world map's land and borders (public/js/scenes/worlddata.js), from Natural Earth 1:50m via the world-atlas package
natural-earth.licence: public domain (Natural Earth terms of use)

open-meteo.what: Forecasts, the heat map and the sky time-lapse of WORLD WEATHER
open-meteo.owner: Open-Meteo.com, from national weather services (ECMWF, DWD, NOAA, Météo-France, Met Office and others)
open-meteo.credit: Weather data by Open-Meteo.com (CC BY 4.0), processed into maps and icons by GLOBIT 24
open-meteo.commercial: The free API is for non-commercial use only; a monetised channel needs a paid API plan (open-meteo.com/en/terms) before launch

gdacs.what: Weather warnings (cyclones, floods, droughts) on WORLD WEATHER
gdacs.owner: GDACS, the UN and European Commission's Global Disaster Alert and Coordination System
gdacs.licence: GDACS terms of use (March 2025): no licence stated; information "as is"; not a substitute for official warnings
gdacs.note: Name GDACS on screen and in descriptions; say alerts come from GDACS and that national weather services issue the official warnings (terms, point 4)

wikidata.what: Who a re-staged public figure is (adult, alive, public role) and the election calendar; never shown on air

commons-footage.what: FILE footage of a link's place (server/footage.js): Wikimedia Commons, free licences only, credited on air FILE · author · licence
commons-footage.licence: per file: CC0, public domain, CC BY, CC BY-SA

picture.what: A story's picture: per item, from the cleared-pictures pipeline (server/pictures.js, images.js, imagesearch.js), credited on air
picture.basis: per item: a licence or a free licence; an outlet's own photo with no licence is not cleared

news-reporting.what: The facts of each story, from the outlet named on screen; quotations of what public figures said, attributed
news-reporting.owner: per outlet (their wording); facts are free
news-reporting.licence: facts are not protected; quotations under the quotation and news-reporting exceptions (InfoSoc Art. 5(3)(c),(d),(f); CDPA s.30) with the source named
